data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 海边漫步
data.description: 【爱蜜莉雅 · 海边漫步】夕阳将平静的海面镀上一层绚丽的碎金，爱蜜莉雅脱下鞋袜赤脚踩在潮湿的浅滩浪花间，任由清凉的海水漫过足踝。她提着裙摆回过头笑靥如花——「海水凉凉的真舒服！昴，快脱掉鞋子一起踩水！这片海真的太美了！」
data.promptProse: Emilia walks barefoot along the shallow wave edge and turns back with an affectionate smile, silver hair lifted by the evening breeze above her comfortable casual outfit. The medium view follows the shoreline behind her, wet sand and small breaking ripples leading toward the horizon. Orange-pink dusk colors her hair edges and the sea surface, while reflected water light softens the lower fabric and darker waves separate the distant horizon.
